sources.masses: Huang and Zhou, 'Precise values of running quark and lepton masses in the Standard Model', Phys. Rev. D 103, 016010 (2021), arXiv:2009.04851v2 (13 Jan 2021); the same PDF as HZ2021_running_masses_MZ.json (sha256 baeddc972002d60140ec54a8a2d378c51bc5e94ca8af9ac97c1164ff1621ceb6, rechecked 2026-10-13). Table 2 (quarks) and Table 3 (charged leptons), the row 'mu = 10^12 GeV, Full SM': the MS-bar running masses at mu = 10^12 GeV in the full Standard Model, defined there as m_f = y_f v_F / sqrt(2) with v_F = 246 GeV. Each uncertainty is the table's combined one. Used by W57 as the second scale (a robustness read-out); the CKM moduli are kept at their low-scale values (B1612_data.json), their running neglected.

scheme: MS-bar, full Standard Model, m_f = y_f v_F / sqrt(2), v_F = 246 GeV
